title: Record eight-source weight-four two-sweep obstruction
body:
## Contribution

Adds an exact, scoped negative result for the eight-source F2 dirty-connector weight-four shell. Among all 40,320 two-sweep words (first sweep fixed by relabeling symmetry), the maximum prefix-difference coverage is 23 of 70 masks; 68 second sweeps attain the maximum. The package includes a witness, exact covered/uncovered masks, a prefix-pair versus direct-interval cross-check, and 23,552 exhaustive dirty-state scalar replays.

This is an obstruction only for the two-complete-sweep, 16-toggle family. It does not rule out other interleaved 16-toggle words, longer paths, or other alphabets. It claims no construction, selected-frontier change, or new kappa.

## Cost screen

The optimistic fully charged target was 156 complete calls (16 source toggles plus two output readouts for each of 70 rows). The direct restored row-by-row schedule costs 700 calls. The tested family does not attain the 156 target. No frame, helper, copy, host, restoration, or precision expense is omitted from this connector-level model.

## Reproduction

`python3 -B research/eight-source-weight-four-seed84083/verify.py`

Expected: `PASS_TWO_SWEEP_WEIGHT_FOUR_CENSUS`, `permutations=40320`, `covered=23/70`, `maximum_attainers=68`.

Package provenance check:
`python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/eight-source-weight-four-seed84083 --check-only`

The exact search and package metadata check passed locally under Python 3.14.7. The generic replay manifest targets Python 3.12; that interpreter is not installed in this environment.
